Nominal data are unordered categories, such as favourite fruits, and can be shown in a bar chart. Ordinal data are ordered categories, such as satisfaction levels, and can be shown in an ordered bar chart. Discrete data are separate, countable values, such as books borrowed, and can be shown in a bar chart. Continuous data are measurements across a range, such as height, and can be shown in a histogram.
